mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification_codes ( email, purpose, code_hash, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{purpose}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, verified_at AS verifiedAt FROM email_verification_codes WHERE id = #{id} AND verified_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT id FROM email_verification_codes WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY verified_at DESC LIMIT 1
